reason: Provides image understanding for DeepSeek Harness by routing specified image files to a configured external vision model and returning text descriptions through the describe_image tool.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供图像理解功能，通过配置的外部视觉模型将指定图片转换为文字描述。
summaries.en: Adds image understanding to DeepSeek Harness by sending specified images to a configured external vision model and returning text descriptions.

capabilities: Reads supported image files from a specified path
Sends image content and an optional prompt to a configured OpenAI-compatible external vision model
Returns a plain-text image description to the main model
Provides a settings interface for configuring the external endpoint, API key, and model
